t: You're looking at St Gabriel's, an Anglo-Catholic parish church in Warwick Square, Pimlico. It was built between 1851 and 1853 as part of Thomas Cubitt's development of the area for the Marquess of Westminster. It's Grade II* listed. The designer was Thomas Cundy the younger, who succeeded his father as surveyor of the Grosvenor Estate. He held that post during the main phase of building in Belgravia and Pimlico, so this church belongs to the larger story of the streets around you.
